segments.speaker: A
segments.text: Good morning, what can I get for you today?

segments.speaker: B
segments.text: Could I have a large latte with oat milk, please?

segments.speaker: A
segments.text: Sure, would you like anything to eat with that?

segments.speaker: B
segments.text: No thanks, just the coffee. Can I pay by card?

segments.speaker: A
segments.text: Of course, please tap your card on the reader.
